title: SYCOPHANCY CLAIMS ABOUT LANGUAGE MODELS: THE MISSING HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and methodological review of 'sycophancy' (a behavioral bias where models adapt output to please users) within AI alignment. While sycophancy touches on concepts of sincerity and human approval, the paper analyzes measurement frameworks and human perception rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious beliefs, theology, or formal moral/ethical systems.
